body:
## Summary

- New generic clause ingester (boilerplate chapters skipped, verbatim verification): GB 15577 x88, GB 12158 x125, GB 15607 x60, limited-space rule x15 clauses ingested with evidence and reviews.
- Generator generalized to all laws; inversion batch 3: 324 hazards.
- Gate: eligibleHazards 706 -> 1030, links 884 -> 1208, strictBlockers=0. r20 live: 1030/173/286/1208.
